comments.author: Emma
comments.body: keep using the bow, forte points will continue to increase as you fight. However you will only gain forte points if your forte is less than 20x the level of the npc you are fighting. for instance, if your forte is 624 and you fight a level 28 npc, it will not increase. To get to 1000 you need to be fighting level 50 npc's.
